The spots appear to have darker centers, some with a slight ring pattern. The leaf remains mostly green. No yellow halos, no powdery coating, no angular lesions.

Top candidates: Bacterial_Pustule, Soybean_rust, Septoria_brown_spot, Frogeye_leaf_spot.

Let me view one reference from each top candidate.
This Bacterial_Pustule reference matches well - small dark reddish-brown spots scattered across green leaf. Very similar to test image. Now checking Soybean_rust.
Soybean_rust also shows very similar small reddish-brown spots across the leaf. Now checking Septoria_brown_spot.
Septoria shows yellow leaves with coalescing dark spots - less similar to the test image. Now checking Frogeye_leaf_spot.

Now I can analyze all four comparisons:

- **Bacterial_Pustule**: The reference (Soybean_Dise_100.jpg) shows nearly identical small, dark reddish-brown spots scattered across a green leaf - very close match to the test image in size, density, and color.
- **Soybean_rust**: Similar small reddish-brown spots but typically present as pustules on the underside; the test image appears to be the upper leaf surface with discrete small spots.
- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Much more yellowing with coalescing blotches - doesn't match.
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Fewer, larger spots with gray centers and distinct reddish-purple margins - doesn't match the dense, small spot pattern.

The test image shows the upper leaf surface with numerous small, discrete, dark reddish-brown circular spots densely scattered across a still-green leaf. This matches Bacterial_Pustule best - small spots with slightly raised/darker centers, scattered pattern, no major yellowing halos, no angular lesion boundaries.
